findings.title: Modern TLS Version Negotiated
findings.explanation: The connection negotiated TLS 1.3, providing optimal cryptographic performance and security.

findings.title: Certificate Valid & CA Trusted
findings.explanation: The X.509 certificate is valid, within its validity window, and issued by a trusted public Certificate Authority.
findings.evidence: Issuer: DigiCert TLS RSA SHA256 2020 CA1

findings.title: Certificate Hostname Match
findings.explanation: The requested target hostname matches the Subject Alternative Name (SAN) list in the certificate.

findings.title: Strong AEAD Cipher Suite
findings.explanation: Uses TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 which provides authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD).

findings.title: HSTS Header Advisory
findings.explanation: HTTP Strict Transport Security header recommendation.
findings.evidence: max-age policy not enforced at socket level.

recommendations.text: Configure Strict-Transport-Security header with max-age=31536000 and includeSubDomains on all HTTPS responses.

steps.title: Client Hello
steps.description: Client initiates handshake offering TLS 1.3, key shares, and supported cipher suites.
steps.purpose: Negotiate version, key exchange parameters, and client random.

steps.title: Server Hello
steps.description: Server selects cipher suite and returns server key share for Diffie-Hellman exchange.
steps.purpose: Establish shared secret key and confirm cipher selection.

steps.title: Server Encrypted Extensions & Certificate
steps.description: Server sends encrypted X.509 certificate chain and Finished verification payload.
steps.purpose: Authenticate server identity and finalize handshake.
